source_snapshot.procedure: The PCIe Qualification Test of system topology.
source_snapshot.criteria: Information readable/no spelling error; FW Version correct.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Expected graph, identity/link checks and log preservation required.

old_problem: The source requests PCIe topology qualification but supplies only readability and firmware Criteria, with no authoritative labeled graph, optional-node policy or link-state oracle.
disposition_reason: Topology collection is a standard read-only operation. ED-03 permits project identities and expected topology to remain runtime configuration; completeness is judged against an approved labeled graph without guessing OEM layout.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row322 all 18 XLSX columns and history2919.
Preserved every root port, switch, bridge, endpoint, optional-node and negotiated-link check.
No log was cleared and no DUT command was run.

test_case.purpose: Prove that the observed labeled PCIe hierarchy and every negotiated link match the approved platform topology.
test_case.test_command: Capture the pinned NVQual topology output and corroborating read-only PCIe inventory; normalize volatile BDFs by stable physical identity and compare all nodes, edges, counts, firmware references, speed and width with the signed graph.
test_case.expected_result: Every mandatory labeled node and edge is present exactly once, optional nodes obey the signed state rules, no unexpected path exists, and every negotiated link equals the approved capable/current speed and width.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires a complete identity-aware graph match and signed link rules; readable text or a correct firmware string alone is insufficient.
safety_gate: No retrain, reset, rescan or log clear
Stop on unstable identity or incomplete reference graph
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected; if collection disturbs a device, stop without retry and hand the preserved evidence to the platform owner for controlled recovery.

source_conflict.reason: Review-layer acceptance now measures topology completeness and link state while retaining readability and firmware as subordinate checks.

blocked.reason: The method is technically defined; platform graph values are runtime prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind the signed labeled topology, stable identities, optional-node rules, link expectations and pinned NVQual artifact.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; RUNTIME CONFIGURATION REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Supply the approved topology package before execution.

project_authority: The physical graph, optional functions and acceptable link states are project-specific.
